utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Vik—book club’s still on, right? I think I missed whether the time changed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll check the book club details and let everyone know the plan soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik—appreciate it. I probably missed the update again, so just let me know once you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help set up the chairs and we can pick the next book together tonight.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works for me — the library next Thursday still sounds best, and I’ll bring a couple of short, lively options tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll help with the chairs tonight, and we can narrow down the short options together at the library next Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, I’m checking on the book club details and want to keep it easy for everyone to jump into this month. If you’ve got any favorite picks, I’d love to hear them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — bring your favorites and we’ll pick one at book club.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll bring a couple favorites to book club and keep an eye out for a simple pick everyone can jump into.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s start at 7 next Thursday, and if people can bring a snack or drink to share, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—Thursday at 7 works for me, and I can bring a snack to share.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks, Dane — I’ll see you next Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still checking the title, but I’ve got the extra chairs and tea ready if book club needs them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just to confirm, do we still have the book club meeting this week? Once you have the time and place, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, the book club is still on this week — I’m just checking the time and place, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh sure, I’ll ask around and let you know the title and meeting time as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep an eye out too, and if it is The Midnight Library, I’ve still got that extra copy to lend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great—if it turns out to be The Midnight Library, your extra copy will come in handy. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the title and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at 7 works for me after pickup—thanks for letting me know. I’ll plan to be there at Quinn’s place on 14 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Faye — Quinn’s place at 14 Maple Street at 7 on Thursday works. I’ll keep it simple and make sure everyone has the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Sam — thanks for handling the details. I’ll be there after pickup on Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’ll bring the mystery novel. Thanks for keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me too — I’ll plan to come by Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, see you Thursday at 7 then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think it’s tonight, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the details myself. Let me check and I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’ve got a couple in mind, so I’ll bring them to book club and we can choose together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, that sounds perfect — bring them along and we’ll pick one together at book club tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the title yet, but I can check the flyer and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rey — that’d be great. I’m still catching up, so just the title is perfect.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll take a look and let you know the title.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just let me know the time and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s Thursday at 7 at my place, 14 Maple Street — hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll be there Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thursday at 7 PM at your place, 14 Maple Street — got it. I’ll tell everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Mina — I’ll make sure the group knows, and I’ll have the space ready at 7.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll let everyone know 7 PM at your place on 14 Maple Street. Thanks, Rosa!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I’m late — Thursday at 7 for "The Midnight Library" works for me. I can swing by and grab Gus’s spare copy if needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane — Thursday at 7 is perfect. If you can grab Gus’s copy, that’d be a big help, and I’ll bring the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll pick up Gus’s spare copy on my way over. Thanks, Sam; see you Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, do we still have the book club meeting this week? If you’ve got the time and place, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — we’re still on for next Thursday at the library. I’ll bring a couple of short, lively options for us to choose from.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just to confirm, next Thursday at the library, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’ll tell everyone to bring a snack or drink if they can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — Thursday at 7 works, and I’ll pass along the snack-or-drink idea to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. See you Thursday at 7 at my place.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — happy to help with the chairs once you send the book pick and time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what book are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help pick it — just send me the time too, and I’ll bring the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the time, but I’ve heard it’s the new mystery novel. If you know anything else about the meeting, I’m all ears.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the details too, but I’ve heard Thursday at 7 at 14 Maple Street. I’d double-check the flyer before making plans.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Pia — Thursday at 7 at 14 Maple Street helps a lot. I’ll still double-check the flyer, but that’s enough for me to keep up for now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good — I’ll bring them along and we can pick one at book club.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — bring both and we’ll pick at book club.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, I’ll bring both.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the day, time, and place for the book club and let you know once I’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Hana — I appreciate you confirming it. I’ll wait to hear back before I bring the book.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m on it — I’ll confirm the day, time, and place and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at 7 works for me after pickup — thanks, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the title and let you know — and if book club needs anything, I’ve still got the extra chairs and tea.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that’s perfect. Let me know the title when you have it, and I appreciate the extra chairs and tea.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and let you know the title as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Tess — I’ll keep everyone posted that we’re meeting Thursday at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks — I’ll keep asking about the title and pass it along once I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re reading "The Night Circus" this month — I kept hearing people mention it at the market, so I finally picked up a copy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, that’s the one with the circus and all the magic, right? I’ll try not to confuse it with my bakery errands this time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s the one — circus, magic, and a lot of atmosphere. If you see me at the market again, I’ll probably be the one carrying it around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re still on for Thursday at 7 at my place, 14 Maple Street—hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I should be able to make it. I’ll check the flyer and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — just let me know if anything comes up. Looking forward to seeing you Thursday at 7 at 14 Maple Street!
